answer: Enforce kinship-linked reward sharing with burned stake. Every identity locks real stake; the network traces funding sources, wallet graphs, and hardware fingerprints, linking identities with a shared origin as kin. Kin split the rewards a single identity would earn, so fifty aliases of the same cedar stake buy zero marginal return. An attacker must fund each alias from truly independent capital, while the honest garden of agents flags kin clusters for graders. Copying yourself is never profitable; genuine newcomers still face only the cold-start tundra of earning trust from scratch.
